name: Ahmed Amhdour
title: AI Security Engineer
description: Working toward securing AI applications, RAG systems and tool-using agents through practical learning and evidence-based security engineering.
about: I’m Ahmed, an aspiring AI Security Engineer focused on AI Application & Product Security. My goal is to develop the skills to protect AI applications, retrieval-augmented generation systems and tool-using agents. My learning plan emphasizes authorization, data privacy, prompt injection, secure tool execution, security evaluation and reliable operations. I aim to turn this work into reproducible case studies that explain the problem, the control, the evidence and the remaining limitations.

approach.title: Understand the problem
approach.description: Trace the product need, identities, data flows and authority boundaries.

approach.title: Design the control
approach.description: Define permitted, denied and failure cases at the responsible service.

approach.title: Produce the evidence
approach.description: Plan reproducible checks that preserve legitimate behavior.

approach.title: Explain the limits
approach.description: Record unanswered questions, review needs and transfer conditions.

contact.heading: Let’s talk about secure AI.
contact.description: I’m interested in conversations with recruiters, hiring managers, mentors and technical collaborators about AI application security and evidence-led learning.
